name: Deity: Zindel of Mournas (Son of the Watcher) (Cleric)

system.description:
Favoured weapon: Sword, Bastard

Granted power: Advantage on saves against fear. Once/day: when an ally within 30ft is hit by an attack, you take the damage instead.

Allegiance: Lawful Good, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Zindel ‘Son of the Watcher’ in the World of Arneyan wiki.
